meta_description: Open-source projects from Topmindspace: Topmind, a personal stream and knowledge workspace (desktop app, Obsidian plugin, skill pack), writing skills, and a presentation skill that builds pageable HTML and editable PPTX.
og_description: Topmind stream and knowledge workspace (desktop app, Obsidian plugin, skill pack), plus writing and presentation skills. Files stay in local Markdown.
footer_verified: Versions checked on 2026-10-10. Each repository's Releases page is the source of truth.
footer_tagline: Open-source tools built around local Markdown.
hero_lede: Open-source tools built around local Markdown: a personal stream and knowledge workspace, and writing and presentation skills. Your files stay on your own disk.
pick_know_d: A stream, clips, and document parsing. Organizing and todos are proposed first.
pick_pres_d: Pageable HTML, with an editable PPTX when you need one.
know_lead: Topmind is the main line. Notes, clips, and documents land on a timeline as Markdown in your workspace. Organizing and todos can be proposed first and written only after you confirm. The desktop app, the Obsidian plugin, and the skill pack share one workspace convention, so pick the entry point that fits how you work.
desk_what: A three-column desktop workbench: a stream timeline plus an AI workspace with Chat, Suggestions, Todos, and Apps tabs. The interface is available in Simplified Chinese and English.
desk_for: People who want a standalone app and a visual place to confirm AI suggestions.
desk_note: The command above is the macOS Homebrew install (the macOS build targets Apple silicon). Windows and Linux builds (.exe, .AppImage, .deb) are on Releases.
desk_shot_suggest_alt: Topmind suggestions panel with items waiting for confirmation
desk_shot_ingest_alt: Topmind knowledge ingest: drop files to convert them to Markdown
obs_what: Opens the stream in Obsidian’s main area. The right sidebar AI panel has Chat, Suggestions, Todos, and History tabs. Changes proposed by AI are written after you confirm, and notes stay as Markdown in your vault.
obs_for: People already on Obsidian who want the stream inside their vault. Requires Obsidian 1.13.0 or later, desktop only.
obs_note: Search for Topmind Stream in Obsidian community plugins, or add the repository above in BRAT.
obs_img_alt: Topmind Stream inside Obsidian: this week’s timeline
skl_what: A skill pack for hosts such as Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, and Hermes. The only daily entry is topmind, which routes to six actions: capture, organize, write, memory, maintain, and loop. Two optional connectors (WeRead and X) and optional bookkeeping are included.
skl_for: People who manage notes inside an agent and do not need the desktop app.
skl_note: The npm installer also installs shared/ and links the skills for several hosts.
pres_what: A skill for formal business decks (TopPPT HTML). Three shapes: a talk, a research report, or an architecture brief. Day to day you page through HTML; export an editable PPTX when the layout needs editing. Nine styles, in light and dark themes.
pres_for: People preparing talks, research reports, or architecture briefs.
pres_note: Requires Node.js 22+. HTML uses only the Python standard library; exporting PPTX also needs Node. npm, the Release zip, and git clone also work (see the README).
pres_sample_a_alt: Talk mode sample: a business-blue cover slide
pres_sample_b_alt: Research mode sample: a mckinsey-style cover slide
pres_sample_c_alt: Architecture mode sample: a graphite-dark cover slide
pp_meta_title: Topmind Presentation — HTML slides and an editable PPTX
pp_meta_description: Topmind Presentation builds formal business decks: a talk, a research report, or an architecture brief. Page through HTML, export an editable PPTX when needed, with nine styles.
pp_lede: The skill is topmind-presentation, branded TopPPT HTML. HTML and PPTX come from one content model: you page through HTML day to day and export an editable PPTX when the layout needs editing.
pp_modes_lead: Pick the shape first, then write. The three images below are the cover slides of the sample reports in the repository.
pp_mode_a_d: A deck for the stage, one claim per screen.
pp_mode_b_d: A research report with exhibits, sources, and takeaway bars.
pp_mode_c_d: An architecture brief built around topology, swimlane, and layered diagrams.
pp_styles_lead: The nine styles switch inside one file: light for sharing, dark for a big screen. The style matrix is below.
pp_styles_alt: Topmind Presentation style matrix: talk, research, and architecture modes across nine styles
pp_tool_lead: Shortcuts available as soon as you open the delivered HTML.
pp_tool_theme_d: Light for sharing, dark for a big screen. Remembered per file.
pp_tool_style_d: Switch among nine styles live. Only the look changes, never the content.
pp_tool_pptx_d: Preview the page sequence and copy a prompt back into the chat to export.
pp_tool_help_d: Explains the two PPTX export routes and their dependencies.
pp_tool_full_d: Immersive presenting, with arrow keys to page.
pp_tool_fold_d: Folds into a mini bar. The position is remembered per file.
pp_foot_lead: The repository README has the full guide and commands.
pick_write_d: WeChat posts, X longform, briefs, covers, and long images.
create_lead: Two separate repositories, installed separately. Writing covers articles, briefs, covers, and long images. Presentation turns content into a deck you can page through.
write_what: Six writing and image skills behind one installer. Install only the ones you need.
write_for: Creators who write WeChat posts, X longform, and short posts, and need covers and long images.
write_note: Replace topmind-wechat-post with any skill name below.
write_img_alt: Topmind Writing Skills cover: WeChat posts, X longform, briefs, and covers
ws_wechat: WeChat articles end to end: delivery pack, review and rewrite, three quality gates, inline layout for WeChat, and a publish checklist.
ws_x: X longform: turn a Markdown draft into text you can paste, with a cover image and a publish checklist.
ws_briefs: Short briefs: explain one thing, with a WeChat version and an X version you can copy in one click.
ws_viral: X short posts: type-based templates with short lines and a prompt to interact, each paired with one image.
ws_cover: Cover images: a style library with recipes, cropped to X and WeChat sizes.
ws_poster: Long images: lay out in HTML, then render a 2x screenshot with headless Chrome for rankings, infographics, and posters.
